chunks: Grant, O Lord, that I and my offspring may remain constant in devotion. Grant, O Lord, my supplication.
ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet pray for regarding his offspring in Surah Ibrahim?
ai.summary: This supplication, known as *Dua al-Ibrahim*, is recited during the Tashahhud in daily prayers, linking the Prophet's personal devotion to the collective worship of the faithful. Shia scholars emphasize its dual focus on individual piety and the preservation of the prophetic lineage, highlighting the continuity of spiritual authority. It serves as a reminder that true worship involves both personal establishment in prayer and the intergenerational transmission of faith.
